facts.identity: Green Namekian, two forehead antennae, pointed ears, pink organic segmented arm patches, purple gi, blue sash and brown-orange boots. No mechanical arm or literal cannon.
facts.technique: Charge with joined index and middle fingertips against the forehead, then release spiral-wrapped ki from those two fingers. The short native beam is a muzzle cue; range and long beam remain gameplay/VFX adaptations.
facts.localPaletteCorrection: The inspected preceding local sprite has a nearly black gi. New native drawings use the recognizable purple gi; the old asset is archived unchanged as reference.

facts.sourceWork: Naruto Shippuden, Fourth Shinobi World War Kakashi before double Mangekyo
facts.identity: Silver spiky hair, lower-face mask, green Konoha flak vest over navy outfit, gloves, white shin wraps and open-toe sandals. One left Sharingan revealed for Kamui, other eye natural dark.
facts.technique: Sharingan gaze and a localized grey space-time distortion. No Susanoo, second Sharingan, eye laser or electrical Raikiri effect is introduced into the super or finale.
facts.phaseSourceMapping: Initial native atlas has seven actual rows, omitting finale. Target phases0/1/2/3/5/6/7 preserve source rows0/1/2/3/4/5/6; the missing finale is four separately generated native poses. No body is split into an invented eighth row or duplicated.

visualReview.limits: Anatomy, exact pose timing, palette details, compact effects and relative body scale across phases are generated adaptations. SHA hashes,64 distinct RGBA cells and inspected sources do not certify original animation fidelity.

knownLocalDebtOutsideThisArtBatch: At generation capture, raw HEROES_DB used gun defaults for Piccolo and Kakashi. Integration now corrects Piccolo to melee and Kakashi to kunai in the final heroOverrides layer. Their original base bitmaps are preserved; the dedicated native presentations and effective authored abilities are distinct from those older images.
